title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Sunday, 27 September 2026
description: Today: Australia's Defence Force builds a 'silicon commander' with AI as automation bias concerns grow; a Sydney hazard reduction burn breaks containment, destroying a fire truck; Brisbane Broncos beat the Gold Coast Titans in the NRLW preliminary final to book a grand final rematch; and Brand Gold Coast pushes to move beyond the 'Glitter Strip' identity. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
